messages.subject: For Kei Uruma | Industrial technology, energy systems and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mitsubishi Electric Public Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Kei Uruma, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Mitsubishi Electric's global portfolio across energy systems, industrial automation, digital infrastructure and mobility operates across complex government, regulatory and sustainability environments. That interface closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder execution might support Mitsubishi Electric's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Mitsubishi Electric.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
